verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a request-based scraping API. Its JavaScript scenarios are per-call browser instructions, not deployable custom scripts. The CLI's crawl and schedule commands, including running Scrapy-project spiders, are not documented as hosting user code on ScrapingBee's infrastructure. These are adjacent features, and the pack has no evidence of building and deploying custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
